lastResponse.text: Yes, closest concrete option I can give is Oregon Health Authority Birth Certificates in Portland. I can’t verify in advance what they’ll bend on, but ask directly about three things: expired ID, alternate identity proof, and an older non-certified birth certificate copy. Also ask about fee waivers or vouchers. Call: 9 7 1, 6 7 3, 1 2 2 2 (or 1 2 9 9). Address: 800 Northeast Oregon Street, Portland.
